resources.title: Open Content Decryption Module (OCDM)
resources.description: Modular W3C EME-compliant Content Decryption Module implementation with CDMi specification support from Fraunhofer FOKUS

resources.title: DRM_PSSH_Decoder
resources.description: Decoder and inspector for DRM PSSH boxes (Widevine, PlayReady, FairPlay, ClearKey) that extracts key IDs, decodes PRO headers, and parses init segments

resources.title: DRMSense
resources.description: Web application for detecting browser DRM capabilities including Widevine (L1/L3), PlayReady, and FairPlay support with license/session persistence checks

resources.title: js_mse_eme
resources.description: YouTube's testing tool for validating browser HTML5 Media Source Extension and Encrypted Media Extension implementations

resources.title: Eyevinn WebRTC Player
resources.description: Open-source WebRTC receive-only player library with WHEP protocol support, extensible media server adapters, RTC stats monitoring, and event handling. Includes online demo and NPM package for browser-based playback.

resources.title: StreamPack - Multiprotocol live streaming broadcaster libraries for Android
resources.description: StreamPack is a lightweight, high-performance toolkit for building streaming video processing pipelines on Android. It provides reusable components for frame sources, transformations, encoding, and output, making it easy to develop efficient real-time video applications with a modular and composable architecture.

resources.title: MediaMolder - FFmpeg for the AI era
resources.description: A rewrite of the interface and orchestration layers of FFmpeg: a graphical interface to visualize, edit, validate and run processing graphs, jobs defined in JSON files, import of any FFmpeg command line, and a real-time encoding control system.

resources.title: QUANTEEC Digital Rights Management
resources.description: QUANTEEC provides a plugin that enables DRM-protected playback by encrypting video data on the server side and decrypting it on the player side. It is compatible with various players and DRM systems, facilitating secure video streaming.

resources.title: uvg266 - Open-source VVC/H.266 Encoder
resources.description: Open-source VVC/H.266 encoder licensed under 3-clause BSD, developed by University of Helsinki's Ultra Video Group. Still under active development with ongoing RD-quality and speed improvements.

resources.title: x266 - Next Generation VVC/H.266 Encoder by MulticoreWare
resources.description: Open-source VVC/H.266 compliant encoder built on top of x265, featuring HDR/WCG support, 360° video encoding, and SDR video. Developed for achieving twice the coding efficiency of HEVC.

resources.title: simple-peer - Simple WebRTC video, voice, and data channels
resources.description: Simple WebRTC library for video, voice, and data channels with a concise API. Supports dynamic stream addition, Node.js usage via wrtc, and works in browsers without configuration. Powers many P2P projects including file sharing and video chat applications.

resources.title: Video Processing Benchmarks and Research
resources.description: Comprehensive video codec benchmarking and research platform with ML-based optimization methods, stereoscopic quality assessment, and codec comparison studies. Includes research on x264/x265 preset optimization and video quality metrics analysis.

resources.title: Axinom Public Test Vectors - Multi-DRM Test Content
resources.description: Public test vectors for adaptive streaming playback and multi-DRM scenarios. Includes working license servers for Widevine, FairPlay, PlayReady, and Clear Key testing with pre-generated license tokens and various test configurations.

resources.title: VVCEasy
resources.description: Ready-to-use prebuilt VVC (H.266) binaries and players for Windows, macOS, Linux, FreeBSD, Haiku, Android, and WebAssembly. Includes vvdec, vvenc, uvg266 encoders/decoders, and FFmpeg builds with VVC support.

resources.title: JVET VVC Test Model (VTM) Reference Software
resources.description: Official overview site for Versatile Video Coding (VVC) and the VVC Test Model (VTM) reference software from the Joint Video Experts Team. Hosts VTM encoder/decoder, experimental JEM software, and Benchmark Set (BMS) tools.

resources.title: VTM Decoder VLC Plugin
resources.description: VVC (H.266) video decoder plugin for VLC Media Player based on a multithreaded VTM decoder implementation. Includes TS demux plugin with VVC stream format support. Enables VVC playback in VLC with configurable threading and hurry-up mode.

resources.title: EdgeCDN-X Open Source CDN
resources.description: EdgeCDN-X is an open source CDN built on Kubernetes with ingress-nginx and CoreDNS for routing, and ArgoCD for fast config distribution to the edges. Supports static upstreams, S3 origins, URL signatures, static IP prefix routing, and geo routing.

resources.title: LiveKit
resources.description: End-to-end stack for WebRTC with a powerful SFU server, client SDKs, and cloud infrastructure. Supports scalable video conferencing, live streaming, and real-time communication with features like adaptive streaming, recording, ingress/egress, and comprehensive APIs for multiple platforms.

resources.title: DVBSnoop
resources.description: An analyzer and debugging tool for MPEG transport streams and DVB broadcasts. It allows inspection of packet structure, tables (PAT, PMT, etc.), and payload of digital video streams.
